subject: Invoice submission: portal vs email + minimal template clarification
messages:

Subject: Invoice routing question for Redwood (portal or email?)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the onboarding call yesterday. Quick operational question from our billing team: once SpryWare is activated, should we submit monthly invoices through Redwood’s vendor portal, or is sending them to billing@redwood.ai still acceptable? We want to make sure PO references and any multi-PO line items are preserved.

Two specifics:
- Is PO "stamping" (putting the Redwood PO in a PDF header) required or is referencing the PO number in the invoice body enough?
- For split-PO invoices (one invoice covering multiple Redwood POs), what minimal fields do you need in a CSV / single-line summary to be auto-ingested if we fall back to email?

I attached our typical PDF sample and our onboarding form (filled). If portal is preferred, what are the subject token and acknowledgement behaviors we should expect?

Appreciate any guidance — we want to avoid delays on the first month.

Best,
Laura Jenkins
VP Finance | SpryWare Inc.
(415) 555-0182

Attachments:
- SpryInvoice_202505.pdf (PDF invoice sample)
- SpryWare_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (completed fields)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Invoice routing question for Redwood (portal or email?)

Hi Laura — thanks for sending the samples and the form. Short answer: portal is preferred for new suppliers because it gives faster ACKs, idempotency, and explicit PO-to-invoice matching. That said, we keep an email fallback for legacy vendors during the first 60 days of activation.

Key points for you:
- PO stamping vs reference: Either works, but for portal ingestion we prefer PO numbers in a structured field (one PO per line) or a CSV with a PO column. For email/PDF fallback, include the PO number in the invoice subject and in the top header of the PDF so our OCR can pick it up reliably.
- Split-PO invoices: If you plan to submit as one invoice covering multiple POs and you want auto-ingestion, provide a CSV with a minimal schema: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), line_item_total, currency, po_number (repeatable per row), vendor_tax_id. If you have only a single-line summary (for smaller partners), include a second file with the line-item breakdown attached and name it with the invoice_number_lines.csv.
- Subject token (portal): when you upload via portal the system issues a confirmation and a short-lived activation token. For email fallback, use subject prefix REDWOOD-PO:<primary_po_number> to help the parser.

Operational checklist (to avoid delays):
1) Upload the onboarding form link you attached to our activation portal link (we’ll complete some fields on our side).
2) If you want to use portal—tell us the user email to provision.
3) For your May invoice sample: please re-send email fallback with subject line: REDWOOD-PO:PO-789123 | inv: SWY-202505 to speed matching.

I’m looping Vanessa (Vendor Ops) and Monica (AP) on details. Vanessa — can you confirm the portal user provisioning SLA? Monica — any ingestion caveats for split-PO PDFs?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — Vanessa here from Vendor Ops. Portal provisioning timeline: 24–48 business hours after we receive the completed onboarding form and W-9 (DocuSign link below). Once provisioned you’ll get a portal confirmation email and an upload guide.

Notes on ingestion exceptions:
- Multi-PO PDFs: our OCR can extract up to 5 PO numbers reliably if they are in the top 2-inch header area. If the PO numbers are embedded in line items only, ingestion may require manual review and create a hold.
- Currency mismatches: include currency on each line or in the CSV header to avoid auto-fail.
- VAT/gst id: include vendor_tax_id in the CSV for EU suppliers.

DocuSign: https://docusign.redwood.com/signer/W9-SWY-4521

If you prefer, we can accept a single XLSX with the same columns.

Thanks — I’ll provision the portal account as soon as the onboarding form and W-9 are complete.

On Fri, Jun 13, 2025 at 4:08 PM Laura Jenkins <laura.jenkins@spryware.com> wrote:
> Quick question before you provision the portal user: can the portal accept one SFTP-based multi-file upload per invoice (PDF + CSV) for larger monthly bundles, or must each invoice be a single portal upload?

Hi Laura — quick follow up from AP. We support two batch patterns:
1) Portal UI / API: single invoice per upload is the default (best for ACKs and idempotency).
2) SFTP batch: we support a single day-end bundle (ZIP) per vendor with a manifest.csv that maps invoice_file -> invoice_number -> primary_po. If you plan to send 8 invoices in a bundle, use the SFTP route and include manifest.csv (columns: file_name,invoice_number,primary_po,invoice_date,total). SFTP onboarding is a second-step integration; ETA for SpryWare is 3–5 business days after portal provisioning.

We’ll follow up on ACT-9427 with onboarding steps for SFTP if you want that route. For now, portal provisioning will let you upload single invoices immediately.

Monica Patel
AP Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
